summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests, mypy, or black, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title classmethod with docstring; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, returning False when not a terminal and otherwise buffering the control and returning True, with the required docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Choices: the console test skip uses sys.platform == "win32"; the CHANGELOG link uses the github.com/Textualize/rich/pull/2200 form. Nothing was verified by execution, so black, mypy, and pytest still need to be run.
